artworks.title: L'amant de lui-mesme
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the knee up in an interior setting. One man is seated with his back to a table, leaning slightly forward, holding a small mirror in one hand. He has long, curly hair and is dressed in period clothing. The other man stands facing him, slightly leaning forward. He has short, curled hair and is also dressed in period attire. The seated man is in an opulently decorated room with ornate furniture and wall panels.

artworks.title: Discours sur l'égalité des conditions: Il retourne chez ses égaux
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered outdoors. Two main figures are depicted, one standing in profile facing the other who is facing away. The first person is dressed in attire typical of the 17th or 18th century, with a long coat, shirt, stockings, shoes, and a wide-brimmed hat. They have European facial features and wavy hair under the hat. The second person is minimally clothed, wearing what seems to be a cloth around their waist. They are muscular and gesturing with their right hand. Several other men in similar period clothing, some with hats and swords, are also visible. The background includes a fenced area, buildings or structures, ships on the water, and clouds in the sky, suggesting an outdoor setting near a port or settlement. There is a bundle on the ground between the two main figures.

artworks.title: Pygmalion
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. The central figure is a nude female person standing on her tiptoes, partially draped with fabric. Her hair is styled in loose waves. To the left, a person is seated on the floor dressed in classical attire, reaching towards the central figure. To the right, another individual is partially visible, interacting with the central figure. In the background, tall columns and curtains frame the scene, creating an opulent setting, potentially a palace or mythological setting. Various objects like a shoe and a jug are scattered on the floor.

artworks.title: La découverte du nouveau monde
artworks.artist: Pietro Antonio Martini after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene with individuals in detailed attire. The scene takes place in a structure with large wooden beams and a thatched roof, where a group of figures is gathered. These figures are adorned in elaborate attire, with feathered and draped garments, and some appear to be engaged with each other. Around them, several figures dressed in European-style clothing are present. The composition includes details like frilled sleeves and patterned skirts, emphasizing the richness of the costumes.

artworks.title: Iphis
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Roman military gathering. The scene showcases a group of Roman soldiers in a setting that suggests a meeting or discussion. The soldiers are depicted wearing classical Roman garb, including helmets, shields, and armored clothing. They are standing on a paved area, potentially a courtyard. In the background, there are more soldiers, some holding spears or standards. The sky is sketched in a way that suggests it is overcast or partially cloudy.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: Dictionnaire de musique
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person outdoors among rocks and trees. The person is wearing a classical robe with long hair and a laurel wreath, holding a quill, with a lyre nearby. A globe is at their feet. The person has a serene expression, looking down. In the background, there is a temple-like structure with other figures nearby, possibly discussing or studying. The setting conveys a sense of classical antiquity and scholarly pursuits in nature.

artworks.title: J'ai tort, mon cher Valère, et t'en demande excuse
artworks.artist: Jean Jacques Le Veau after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in 18th-century clothing standing in an architectural setting with large columns in the background. The woman wears a dress and a cap, gesturing with one hand. The two men are dressed in coats, breeches, and stockings, with one wearing a tricorne hat. They appear to be interacting, with one holding a hat and the other's hand on his shoulder. The scene is set against classical architecture with columns and a stone floor.

artworks.title: La nuit
artworks.artist: Emmanuel Jean Nepomucène de Ghendt after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: In the image, two people are shown in a forest setting. The woman is lying on the ground, leaning back against a tree, with her face angled upward toward the man who is bent over her. Both individuals' bodies are partially visible, as they are intertwined in a close embrace. The woman has delicate facial features and her hair is styled elegantly, adorned with a decorative headpiece. She wears an elaborate dress with ample fabric and ruffled details. The man, who has short hair, is wearing a long coat and trousers. A small statue of a cherub or angel is visible on the right side, sitting on a pedestal against a large tree. The scene is surrounded by dense foliage, including bushes, trees, and a rich ground cover of plants and grass.

artworks.title: Rose et Colas
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin

artworks.title: L'assemblee au salon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an opulent interior scene in a classical style. The room features tall, fluted columns, adorned arches, chandeliers, decorative ceiling details, draped windows, finely crafted furniture, and a geometric floor pattern. Lush fabrics and luxurious decor create a sophisticated atmosphere reminiscent of high-society settings. The scene lacks human presence, focusing on the architecture and furniture.

artworks.title: Le bal paré
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ballroom scene with elegant chandeliers, grand curtains, intricate wall decorations, and a detailed patterned floor. The illustration conveys a sense of grandeur and elegance in a sophisticated interior setting.

artworks.title: La Félicité villageoise
artworks.description: The image shows four people in an indoor setting. A man and a woman stand in the center, with the man leaning over the woman. The woman is seated, holding a piece of paper. The man has dark hair and is dressed in a coat and light-colored pants. The woman has light-colored hair pulled back under a cap and wears a long dress. To the left, two children are partially visible. The room is cluttered with a basket of laundry, a jug, dishes, papers, and cloth on the floor. A basket with fabric hangs overhead, and a ladder rests against the wall. An open doorway reveals a curtain.

artworks.title: La vertu chancelante
artworks.description: The image displays a woman seated on a wooden chair in an attic-like room. She has a calm expression and styled hair, wearing a long dress while holding an object that looks like yarn. Nearby, there is a basket with more yarn. The room has visible beams and a slanted window letting in light, with minimal furniture and a simple bed in the background.

artworks.title: Little Venice
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 18.42 x 26.67 cm (7 1/4 x 10 1/2 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 19.21 x 26.67 cm (7 9/16 x 10 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image features a cityscape viewed from a body of water. The horizon is near the center, with a line of buildings, including domes and towers, suggesting a historic city, potentially Venice. The city is depicted with delicate linework, providing an impressionistic feel. The lines are intricate, creating a sense of lightness. The color palette is understated, with sepia and black tones, offering a vintage appearance. The scene is serene, with the water mirroring the skyline and faint sketches of boats and poles adding depth and calm.

artworks.title: Nocturne
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a calm body of water with a horizon line approximately one third from the bottom. Along the horizon, there are ships with tall masts, including a large ship slightly left of center. To the right, there are buildings, possibly a cityscape, with a tall structure resembling a lighthouse or tower. The image features soft, blur-like brushstrokes, creating a dreamlike quality. The color palette consists of monochromatic tones of gray, enhancing the serene atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: The Little Mast
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: This is a detailed sketch of a bustling waterfront scene. The horizon is towards the upper third of the image, showing ships docked. A tall pole is in the center, intersecting the horizon. The sketch showcases buildings along the street with small figures. The intricate lines vary in thickness, adding depth and texture. The lines continue into the distance, fading into ships and sky. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Little Lagoon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.86 x 15.24 cm (9 x 6 in.)
sheet (with tab): 23.5 × 15.24 cm (9 1/4 × 6 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a calm water body with distant shores visible. Buildings and masts of ships are silhouetted against the horizon line. Boats with tall masts are seen in the middle distance, reflecting on the water. Closer, smaller boats with figures can be seen. The sky is lightly cloudy, indicating a gentle day. The artwork has a minimalistic color palette dominated by tan and sepia tones, emphasizing tranquil atmosphere and intricate linework.

artworks.title: The Palaces
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a row of buildings along a canal resembling a scene from Venice. The perspective is from across the water with several gondolas gliding along. The buildings have arched windows, ornate facades, and balustrades. The artwork is an etching with fine, deliberate lines creating texture. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of sepia and muted browns. The canal's surface reflects parts of the buildings.

artworks.title: The Doorway
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (includes tab with signature): 30.16 × 20.32 cm (11 7/8 × 8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural entrance with intricate details. The image depicts a detailed facade featuring an arched doorway framed by intricate lattice work and floral motifs. The overall feel of the sketch suggests grandeur and historical significance.

artworks.title: The Piazzetta
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 25.72 x 18.1 cm (10 1/8 x 7 1/8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 26.35 x 18.1 cm (10 3/8 x 7 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image features an urban plaza scene with a ground-level perspective. On the left side, there is an ornate tower and a church dome with detailed architectural features such as arches and pointed rooftops. The horizon is high in the composition, outlined by structures and a distant balustrade. The sketchy brushstrokes give a sense of movement, capturing people scattered throughout the scene. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia. In the distance, there is a clock face and tower partially obscured by flagpoles. Close to us, there are people sitting on steps, interacting, or walking, contributing to the historical urban ambiance of the etching.

artworks.title: The Traghetto, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image depicts an intimate courtyard scene with two figures standing and conversing on the left side. The courtyard is shaded by a tree, leading to an archway in the middle distance, where a group of people are seated around a table engaging in discussion. The background shows a tall tree and the walls of adjacent buildings. The composition focuses on the enclosure created by the courtyard walls and overhead foliage. The brushstrokes and etching lines are delicate and sketch-like, giving an impressionistic feel. The color palette is muted and monochromatic, dominated by warm sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Riva, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene from an elevated perspective. Buildings line the water's edge with ship masts in the background. Linear sketch-like techniques are used to show architecture, figures, movement, and activity. People are walking along the quay, boats are moored nearby, and detailed buildings are seen in the distance. The color palette is sepia and black, creating a historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Two Doorways
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a canal cityscape with buildings and a waterway. A man is seen at the edge of the water near an arched doorway, implying movement. The artwork appears to be an etching with detailed textures and a monochromatic sepia color palette. The scene features tall buildings and smaller architectural details in the distance.

artworks.title: The Beggars
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (includes tab with signature): 31.12 × 20.96 cm (12 1/4 × 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban passageway with shadowy figures. The composition includes a cobblestone path leading through a tunnel, framed by dark, textured walls. The path leads to a lighter area in the background with architecture and windows, suggesting buildings. In the foreground, subtle shadowy forms of individuals can be seen. The intricate line work and shading create an atmosphere of transition between light and dark spaces, emphasizing the tunnel's shadowy nature.
